approaches_tried.approach: Rewrote lean-implementation-agent.md/-hard-agent.md detach/wait prose using 'never' as the sole guard word
approaches_tried.reason: Check K's PROHIBITIVE_MARKER_PATTERN is the literal set MUST NOT|forbidden|prohibited|antipattern, case-sensitive; 'never' does not match it, so three windows (lean-implementation-agent.md:345; lean-implementation-hard-agent.md:252,466) still paired run_in_background with completion notification inside the window with no recognized marker, producing 2 real Check K FAILs on the first Phase 5 lint run. Fixed by rewording those three passages to use 'forbidden'/'prohibited' explicitly.

deviations.description: Discharging Check K's exclusions surfaced 2 genuine Check K FAILs on lean-implementation-agent.md (1 site) and lean-implementation-hard-agent.md (2 sites) -- Phase 3's rewording used 'never' as the sole guard word around a run_in_background/completion-notification pairing, which Check K's PROHIBITIVE_MARKER_PATTERN (MUST NOT|forbidden|prohibited|antipattern) does not recognize.
deviations.reason: These two files are not in Phase 5's own file_scope-declared edit list, but the fix is required to make Phase 5's own discharge land green rather than merely assumed green -- discharging the exclusion without this fix would have reintroduced the measured antipattern as a real Check K FAIL, discovered only because the exclusion removal made Check K actually evaluate these files.
deviations.annotation: Re-edited the three affected passages to use 'forbidden'/'prohibited' explicitly instead of 'never', preserving the same substantive meaning. Both files remain within task 376's own declared file_scope (set at plan time), so no scope-excursion issue was recorded.
